qa_pair.question: Using the android-studio tools, report the exact Android Studio build number that is installed (the full build string, e.g. from as_status).

What is the major version of the bundled JBR Java runtime used as JAVA_HOME for builds?
On which localhost TCP port does Android Studio's built-in web server listen (the one this MCP targets for live-IDE calls)?
What is the highest installed Android build-tools version on this machine?
How many Android SDK platforms (android-XX) are installed? Count the entries under the SDK's platforms directory.
What Gradle distribution version does a project created by as_project_create reference in its wrapper properties?
What Android Gradle Plugin (AGP) version does a project scaffolded by as_project_create use?
What is the default minSdk value used by as_project_create when none is specified?
